en: Black‑and‑white view of an elegant European spa town or resort. In the foreground is a landscaped park with manicured lawns, shrubs, conifers, a small pond and a low waterfall. On a small rise stands a pavilion or colonnade covered in greenery. Behind the trees are large ornate late‑19th‑century hotel buildings with elaborate facades, balconies and turrets; one has a domed corner tower. A sign on the distant roof appears to contain the word "KURHAUS" or similar, suggesting a grand spa hotel. The overall look is that of a historic postcard photograph.
